keyResults.statement: Linking forms are symmetric or antisymmetric according to the parity of the product of codimensions (1-forms in 3D force antisymmetry), signed invariants cancel between oppositely-linked pairs, and the asymptotic crossing number is the symmetric substitute that is nonzero when the linking number vanishes.
